analysis_window: first 8 actual board-clock seconds after recorded motion-start STATE. No sample-count duration estimates.
episode_bounds: entry between previous non-mode3 and first mode3 sample; exit between last mode3 and next non-mode3. Contiguous episodes split at >30 ms telemetry gaps.
actuation_caveat: Acceleration/velocity are firmware commanded trajectory values, not measured motor acceleration. Finite differences expose interval-average jerk; near-cap fractions are duration weighted over same-mode intervals, without rail-brake latches.

camera.source_clock_mapping: native board plus per-run 1st percentile serial-receipt offset; camera t is host-read, not exposure
